results.condition: Validate catalog strategy `zscore_strategy` on NSE NIFTY-50 daily data per research/AGENT_BRIEF.md — TRAIN-select within a declared 5-variant budget, then one-shot TEST evaluation vs buy-and-hold, random control, and nsealgo composite. Deliver research/agent_zscore/REPORT.md with an honest verdict.
results.evidence:
TEST (2024-01-01 → 2026-10-01, 684 bars, net of 21.92 bps), engine_sha=970713f3eecf stable across all runs:
- zscore_strategy V5 (L=60, entry=0.5): CAGR 5.17%, Sharpe -0.09, Calmar 0.41, MaxDD -12.52%, turnover 3.87x/y, cost drag 1.90%/y, 13.8 avg names, 61.0% avg invested, 34.5% live.
- buy-and-hold: CAGR 8.45%, Sharpe 0.20, MaxDD -15.90%. Composite: CAGR 6.04%, Sharpe 0.03.
- Strategy loses to BH by 3.28 pts CAGR / 0.29 Sharpe; loses to composite by 0.86 pts.
- Drawdown 'advantage' REVERSES at matched exposure: BH at 61% has MaxDD -8.98% vs strategy -12.52% (3.54 pts better).
- Random control (20 seeds): strategy at 30th pct on TRAIN, 75th pct on TEST, random CAGR 2.35-6.56% vs BH 8.45% — none beat BH.
- Alpha +0.22%/y, beta 0.585.
- TRAIN rank IC +0.043 (t=8.95) at 21d; cross-sectional z at 63d IC +0.076 (t=16.70).
Variant budget: 5 declared, 5 used. TEST read once (variant frozen, engine_sha asserted).
